description: Review buyer-supplied supplier evidence for risk and freshness gaps, then prepare negotiation actions using the generated review as context. Confirm every risk against its original evidence. Fixed sequence: risk (supplier-risk, $15) → negotiation (negotiation, $15). Separate invoices per stage; completed stages remain consumed if a later stage fails. No atomic bundle charge or automatic transfer.

consentExternalProcessing.description: Required: authorize external processing for this workflow.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable caller key for exactly one logical workflow request.

maxChargeUsd.description: Maximum charge authorized across the recipe; each paid stage still requires its own supplied invoice.
